"""Medium/Blogger Search Tool for Agentic RL technical discussions.

Provides simplified but practical blog article retrieval and quality filtering.

Features:
- Blog article search by keywords
- Author credibility assessment
- Article quality scoring
- Key technical article identification
- Technical depth evaluation

Note: This is a simplified implementation using web search approach.
"""

import requests
import time
import logging
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
import json
import re

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class EnhancedMediumSearchTool:
    """Medium/Blogger search tool for technical discussions."""
    
    SEARCH_ENDPOINTS = {
        "medium": "http/workspace/medium.com/search",
        "google_blog": "http/workspace/www.google.com/search"
    }
    
    RATE_LIMIT_DELAY = 2.0
    MAX_RETRIES = 2
    TIMEOUT = 20
    
    QUALITY_KEYWORDS = [
        "implementation",
        "tutorial",
        "deep dive",
        "analysis",
        "best practices",
        "guide",
        "case study"
    ]
    
    def __init__(self, max_results: int = 10, retry_count: int = 2):
        self.max_results = max_results
        self.retry_count = retry_count
        
        self.session = requests.Session()
        
        self.cache_path = Path("knowledge_base/medium_cache")
        self.cache_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        logger.info("="*70)
        logger.info("Medium/Blogger工具初始化完成")
        logger.info("="*70)
        logger.info(f"  最大结果数: {self.max_results}")
        logger.info(f"  重试次数: {self.retry_count}")
        logger.info(f"  质量关键词: {len(self.QUALITY_KEYWORDS)}个")
        
    def search_articles(self, keywords: List[str], time_range_hours: int = 168) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Search technical blog articles by keywords."""
        logger.info("\n" + "="*70)
        logger.info("Medium/Blogger文章搜索开始")
        logger.info("="*70)
        
        all_articles = []
        
        search_queries = [
            "Agentic Reinforcement Learning tutorial",
            "LLM Agent implementation guide",
            "Multi-Agent RL deep dive",
            "Autonomous Agent best practices"
        ]
        
        for query in search_queries[:2]:
            logger.info(f"\n搜索查询: {query}")
            
            articles = self._search_medium_mock(query, time_range_hours)
            
            if articles:
                all_articles.extend(articles)
                logger.info(f"  ✓ 找到 {len(articles)} 篇文章")
            
            time.sleep(self.RATE_LIMIT_DELAY)
        
        unique_articles = self._deduplicate_articles(all_articles)
        
        quality_filtered = self._filter_by_quality(unique_articles)
        
        logger.info(f"\n总计找到 {len(quality_filtered)} 篇高质量文章")
        
        return quality_filtered
    
    def _search_medium_mock(self, query: str, time_range_hours: int) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

        logger.info("  使用Mock数据演示功能")

                except ValueError:

        return filtered_articles[:self.max_results]
    
    def assess_author_credibility(self, author_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Assess author credibility based on available indicators."""

            "author_name": author_name,

        }
        
        logger.info(f"  ✓ 可信度评估完成")
        logger.info(f"    可信度评分: {credibility['credibility_score']}/10")
        logger.info(f"    总文章数: {credibility['total_articles']}")
        
        return credibility
    
    def get_article_details(self, article_url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get detailed information about a specific article."""
        logger.info(f"\n获取文章详情: {article_url}")
        
        details = {
            "url": article_url,
            "title": "Sample Article Title",
            "author": "Sample Author",
            "publication": "Medium",
            "published_date": "2026-04-10",
            "reading_time": 12,
            "claps": 850,
            "comments": 45,
            "word_count": 3000,
            "code_blocks": 3,
            "images": 5,
            "quality_score": 9,
            "technical_depth": "high",
            "source": "medium"
        }
        
        logger.info(f"  ✓ 文章详情获取成功")
        logger.info(f"    质量评分: {details['quality_score']}/10")
        logger.info(f"    技术深度: {details['technical_depth']}")
        
        return details
    
    def _filter_by_quality(self, articles: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Filter articles by quality indicators."""
        
        filtered = []
        
        for article in articles:
            quality_score = article.get("quality_score", 0)
            
            if quality_score >= 7:
                is_technical = article.get("is_technical", False)
                has_code = article.get("has_code_examples", False)
                
                if is_technical or has_code:
                    filtered.append(article)
        
        return sorted(filtered, key=lambda x: x["quality_score"], reverse=True)
    
    def _deduplicate_articles(self, articles: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Remove duplicate articles based on title."""
        unique = []
        seen_titles = set()
        
        for article in articles:
            title = article.get("title", "").lower()
            
            if title not in seen_titles:
                unique.append(article)
                seen_titles.add(title)
        
        return unique
    
    def _calculate_quality_score(self, article: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        """Calculate quality score from article indicators."""
        claps = article.get("claps", 0)
        comments = article.get("comments", 0)
        reading_time = article.get("reading_time", 0)
        has_code = article.get("has_code_examples", False)
        
        score = 5
        
        if claps > 1000:
            score += 2
        elif claps > 500:
            score += 1
        
        if comments > 50:
            score += 1
        
        if reading_time > 10:
            score += 1
        
        if has_code:
            score += 1
        
        return min(10, score)

"""Real Medium/Blog Search Tool for Agentic RL technical discussions.

IMPORTANT: This tool does NOT return fake/mock data.
If real data cannot be obtained, it returns empty results rather than fake data.

Features:
- Real blog article search (not mock)
- Quality filtering based on real indicators
- Data verification before returning

Note: Medium has no official API. We use alternative approaches:
1. RSS feeds from tech publications
2. Direct URL validation
3. If data unavailable, return empty list (NOT fake data)
"""

import requests
import time
import logging
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
import json
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class RealMediumSearchTool:
    """Real Medium/Blog search tool - NO MOCK DATA."""

    TECH_RSS_FEEDS = [
        {
            "name": "Towards Data Science",
            "url": "http/workspace/medium.com/feed/towards-data-science",
            "category": "data-science"
        },
        {
            "name": "Machine Learning Mastery",
            "url": "http/workspace/machinelearningmastery.com/feed/",
            "category": "ml"
        },
        {
            "name": "The Gradient",
            "url": "http/workspace/thegradient.pub/feed/",
            "category": "ai-research"
        },
        {
            "name": "DeepMind Blog",
            "url": "http/workspace/deepmind.com/blog/feed",
            "category": "research"
        }
    ]

    RL_KEYWORDS = [
        "reinforcement learning",
        "agent",
        "LLM",
        "autonomous",
        "multi-agent",
        "policy gradient",
        "PPO",
        "world model"
    ]

    RATE_LIMIT_DELAY = 2.0
    TIMEOUT = 20

    def __init__(self, max_results: int = 10, retry_count: int = 2):
        self.max_results = max_results
        self.retry_count = retry_count

        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.session.headers.update({
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; AgenticRL-Bot/1.0)"
        })

        self.cache_path = Path("knowledge_base/medium_cache")
        self.cache_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        logger.info("="*70)
        logger.info("Medium/Blog搜索工具初始化（真实数据版）")
        logger.info("="*70)
        logger.info("  重要: 本工具不返回假数据")
        logger.info("  如无法获取真实数据，返回空列表")
        logger.info(f"  RSS源数: {len(self.TECH_RSS_FEEDS)}")

    def search_articles(self, keywords: List[str], time_range_hours: int = 168) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Search real articles from RSS feeds - NO MOCK DATA."""
        logger.info("\n" + "="*70)
        logger.info("Medium/Blog真实文章搜索")
        logger.info("="*70)
        logger.info("  重要: 只返回真实数据，无假数据")

        all_articles = []

        for feed_info in self.TECH_RSS_FEEDS:
            logger.info(f"\n检查RSS源: {feed_info['name']}")

            try:
                articles = self._fetch_rss_feed(feed_info, time_range_hours)

                if articles:
                    filtered = self._filter_by_keywords(articles, keywords)
                    all_articles.extend(filtered)
                    logger.info(f"  ✓ 找到 {len(filtered)} 篇相关文章")
                else:
                    logger.info(f"  ⚠ 无数据或RSS不可访问")

                time.sleep(self.RATE_LIMIT_DELAY)

            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"  ⚠ RSS获取失败: {e}")
                continue

        unique_articles = self._deduplicate_articles(all_articles)

        logger.info(f"\n总计: {len(unique_articles)} 篇真实文章")
        logger.info("  所有文章数据来源于真实RSS/API")
        logger.info("  无mock数据，无假数据")

        return unique_articles[:self.max_results]

    def _fetch_rss_feed(self, feed_info: Dict, time_range_hours: int) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Fetch real articles from RSS feed."""
        url = feed_info["url"]

        try:
            response = self.session.get(url, timeout=self.TIMEOUT, verify=self.ssl_verify)

            if response.status_code != 200:
                logger.warning(f"  RSS返回状态码: {response.status_code}")
                return []

            content = response.content

            try:
                root = ET.fromstring(content)
            except ET.ParseError:
                logger.warning("  RSS解析失败")
                return []

            articles = []
            cutoff_date = datetime.now() - timedelta(hours=time_range_hours)

            for item in root.findall(".//item"):
                try:
                    title_elem = item.find("title")
                    link_elem = item.find("link")
                    pub_date_elem = item.find("pubDate")
                    desc_elem = item.find("description")

                    if not title_elem or not link_elem:
                        continue

                    title = title_elem.text or ""
                    link = link_elem.text or ""

                    pub_date = None
                    if pub_date_elem and pub_date_elem.text:
                        try:
                            pub_date = datetime.strptime(
                                pub_date_elem.text[:25],
                                "%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S"
                            )
                        except ValueError:
                            pub_date = datetime.now()

                    if pub_date and pub_date < cutoff_date:
                        continue

                    description = desc_elem.text if desc_elem else ""

                    article = {
                        "title": title,
                        "url": link,
                        "published_date": pub_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if pub_date else "Unknown",
                        "source": feed_info["name"],
                        "category": feed_info["category"],
                        "excerpt": description[:200] if description else "",
                        "quality_score": self._calculate_quality_score(title, description),
                        "verified": self._verify_url_exists(link),
                        "verification_time": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    }

                    articles.append(article)

                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"  文章解析错误: {e}")
                    continue

            return articles

        except requests.RequestException as e:
            logger.warning(f"  RSS请求失败: {e}")
            return []

    def _filter_by_keywords(self, articles: List[Dict], keywords: List[str]) -> List[Dict]:
        """Filter articles by RL keywords."""
        filtered = []

        rl_keywords = keywords if keywords else self.RL_KEYWORDS

        for article in articles:
            title = article.get("title", "").lower()
            excerpt = article.get("excerpt", "").lower()
            combined = title + " " + excerpt

            for keyword in rl_keywords:
                if keyword.lower() in combined:
                    article["matched_keyword"] = keyword
                    filtered.append(article)
                    break

        return filtered

    def _calculate_quality_score(self, title: str, description: str) -> int:
        """Calculate quality score based on real content indicators."""
        score = 5

        quality_indicators = [
            "tutorial",
            "implementation",
            "deep dive",
            "analysis",
            "guide",
            "case study",
            "best practices"
        ]

        combined = (title + " " + description).lower()

        for indicator in quality_indicators:
            if indicator in combined:
                score += 1

        return min(10, score)

    def _verify_url_exists(self, url: str) -> bool:
        """Verify URL actually exists (lightweight check)."""
        if not url:
            return False

        try:
            response = self.session.head(url, timeout=10, allow_redirects=True)
            return response.status_code < 400
        except:
            return False

    def _deduplicate_articles(self, articles: List[Dict]) -> List[Dict]:
        """Remove duplicate articles."""
        unique = []
        seen_urls = set()

        for article in articles:
            url = article.get("url", "")

            if url and url not in seen_urls:
                unique.append(article)
                seen_urls.add(url)

        return unique

    def get_article_details(self, article_url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get details of a specific article - returns real data only."""
        logger.info(f"\n获取文章详情: {article_url}")

        try:
            response = self.session.get(article_url, timeout=self.TIMEOUT)

            if response.status_code != 200:
                logger.warning(f"  文章访问失败: {response.status_code}")
                return {"url": article_url, "error": "Article not accessible", "verified": False}

            content = response.text

            title_match = re.search(r'<title[^>]*>([^<]+)</title>', content)
            title = title_match.group(1).strip() if title_match else "Unknown"

            details = {
                "url": article_url,
                "title": title[:200],
                "verified": True,
                "verification_time": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                "source": "real_fetch"
            }

            logger.info(f"  ✓ 文章验证成功")
            return details

        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"  ✗ 文章获取失败: {e}")
            return {"url": article_url, "error": str(e), "verified": False}


MediumSearchTool = RealMediumSearchTool


if __name__ == "__main__":
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)

    tool = RealMediumSearchTool(max_results=10)

    keywords = ["reinforcement learning", "agent", "LLM"]
    articles = tool.search_articles(keywords, time_range_hours=168)

    print(f"\n找到 {len(articles)} 篇真实文章")

    if articles:
        print("\n文章列表:")
        for article in articles:
            print(f"  - {article['title'][:50]}... (来源: {article['source']})")
    else:
        print("\n无可用真实文章数据（本工具不返回假数据）")

import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import medium_search


def test_has_tech_rss_feeds():
    """The tool should have TECH_RSS_FEEDS with real RSS feed URLs."""
    tool = medium_search.RealMediumSearchTool()
    assert hasattr(tool, 'TECH_RSS_FEEDS'), "Should have TECH_RSS_FEEDS"
    assert len(tool.TECH_RSS_FEEDS) >= 4, "Should have multiple RSS feeds"
    for feed in tool.TECH_RSS_FEEDS:
        assert 'url' in feed
        assert 'name' in feed
        assert feed['url'].startswith('http'), "Feed URL should be real HTTP URL"


def test_has_fetch_rss_feed_method():
    """The tool should have _fetch_rss_feed method for real data fetching."""
    tool = medium_search.RealMediumSearchTool()
    assert hasattr(tool, '_fetch_rss_feed'), "Should have _fetch_rss_feed method"
    assert callable(tool._fetch_rss_feed), "_fetch_rss_feed should be callable"


def test_no_mock_search_method():
    """The tool should NOT have _search_medium_mock method."""
    tool = medium_search.RealMediumSearchTool()
    assert not hasattr(tool, '_search_medium_mock'), "Should not have _search_medium_mock method"


def test_returns_empty_list_when_no_data():
    """When no data is available, should return empty list, not mock data."""
    tool = medium_search.RealMediumSearchTool()

    with patch.object(tool, '_fetch_rss_feed', return_value=[]), \
         patch('medium_search.time.sleep'):
        results = tool.search_articles(["reinforcement learning"])

    assert results == [], "Should return empty list when no data available, not mock data"
    assert len(results) == 0


def test_does_not_return_hardcoded_mock_articles():
    """The tool should not return hardcoded mock article titles."""
    tool = medium_search.RealMediumSearchTool()

    mock_titles = [
        "Building Autonomous Agents with LLMs and Reinforcement Learning",
        "Deep Dive into Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Systems",
        "World Models for Agent Planning: A Tutorial",
        "PPO Algorithm Implementation from Scratch"
    ]

    with patch.object(tool, '_fetch_rss_feed', return_value=[]), \
         patch('medium_search.time.sleep'):
        results = tool.search_articles(["test"])

    for article in results:
        assert article.get('title', '') not in mock_titles, "Should not return mock data"


def test_tool_initialization():
    """The tool should be initializable with max_results and retry_count."""
    if hasattr(medium_search, 'RealMediumSearchTool'):
        tool = medium_search.RealMediumSearchTool(max_results=5, retry_count=1)
    else:
        tool = medium_search.EnhancedMediumSearchTool(max_results=5, retry_count=1)

    assert tool.max_results == 5
    assert tool.retry_count == 1
    assert hasattr(tool, 'search_articles'), "Should have search_articles method"
